product.name: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
product.description:
Immerse yourself in the next level of audio experience with our Wireless Bluetooth Headphones — a perfect fusion of cutting-edge technology, sleek design, and all-day comfort. Whether you're commuting, working out, or just relaxing at home, these headphones deliver high-fidelity sound with deep bass, crisp mids, and clear highs.

Powered by Bluetooth 5.3, they offer seamless connectivity with your devices, enhanced battery efficiency, and a range of up to 15 meters. The Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) technology ensures that nothing interrupts your focus, whether you're on a call or lost in your favorite playlist.

A full charge gives you up to 30 hours of playback, and the headphones come with fast-charging support—10 minutes of charge gives you 3 hours of use. The adjustable headband, soft ear cushions, and lightweight build make them ideal for extended wear.

Built-in controls let you answer calls, adjust volume, and change tracks without reaching for your device. And with IPX4 water resistance, they’re safe from sweat and splashes—perfect for everyday use.
